_about: General terms used on many pages. Owner: supervisor. Other writers: reuse these ids; do not redefine them. Each batch adds its own terms in src/glossary/<batch>.json.

kv-store.short: A store that keeps values under keys. You put a value with a key, and get it back with the same key.

commit.short: One saved version of a git repository. A 40-character id names it. This site explains one pinned commit.

citation.short: A link to a file and line in the code. Every claim about the code on this site has one.
